blocking_reasons.1_verifier_deploy: The canonical gate requires an EXTERNAL Publish-Approval verifier (HMAC/token, non-weakened per the canonical contract). Claude has NO deploy capability for it: no Render deploy access, cannot git push (clone not reachable from sandbox; only an Actions-scoped token exists), and no deploy MCP is available. Deploying via a browser to Render would require signing into Nitin's Render account (prohibited: no credential entry / account actions).
blocking_reasons.2_secret_provisioning: The verifier needs a signing secret + an authenticated Make apikey. Claude must never handle, enter, or transmit secrets/keys. These must be provisioned by Nitin in Render/Make environment storage.
blocking_reasons.3_no_weakening_allowed: A Make-native datastore-only gate WOULD satisfy the mechanics but WEAKENS the proven contract (authority would become forgeable by anyone with Make datastore write access — the same class of flaw as the original 'New' bypass). The phase explicitly forbids weakening, so this is not an acceptable substitute.
blocking_reasons.consequence: Without a deployed, reachable, authenticated verifier, the POSITIVE E2E (valid approval -> gate PASS -> mock boundary) cannot be proven, and the success gate cannot be met. Mutating live P1 to call a non-existent verifier would be a half-done production change (block-all) that still cannot prove the contract, so per the STOP rule Claude did NOT mutate P1.
